verdict.rationale: Elastic documents self-managed deployment options ("Deploy anywhere: on-prem or in private or public cloud") and a one-line Docker start-local quickstart. Community reports independently confirm production self-hosting via the ECK Kubernetes operator and plain StatefulSets, and note the Elastic License/AGPL terms permit self-hosting. Missing for 10: the only quoted install guidance is the start-local quickstart, which is scoped to local development and testing, so there is no in-pack production self-managed install documentation; community reports also say some features (e.g. security in older versions) were gated behind paid licenses when self-hosted.
